text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text:
This was found dropped at the workshop's back entrance... What is it?
I don't really know, but I'll give it to you Uncle!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これ、
工房の勝手口に落ちてたんだけど……
なんだろ？
よくわかんないけど、
おじちゃんにあげるよ！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text:
Ah! If it's something indecent, it's probably Rui-chan's,
so return it under her bed~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ！　
破廉恥なものだったら、
多分ルイちゃんのだから
ベッドの下に返してあげてね～♪
